keyEvents.text: Goal! Union Berlin 1, FC Cologne 0. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tim Skarke.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Zeno Van den Bosch (Union Berlin) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
keyEvents.shortText: Zeno Van Den Bosch Yellow Card

keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Saïd El Mala (FC Cologne).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (FC Cologne) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Paul Okon-Engstler (FC Cologne) is shown the yellow card.
Kastriot Imeri (Union Berlin) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, FC Cologne. Alessio Castro-Montes replaces Sebastian Sebulonsen.
Substitution, FC Cologne. Mikey Moore replaces Ísak Jóhannesson.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Aljoscha Kemlein replaces Kastriot Imeri.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Oliver Burke replaces Tim Skarke.
